add-guest-management-functionality-to-ex.reason: At the merge, addGuests.handler.ts filtered guests with `guest === attendee.email` and `blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)` on raw strings, so case variants passed. PR #24298 (2025-10-15, email verification setting) rewrote the filter: guests are deduplicated by extractBaseEmail(guest).toLowerCase(), and the attendee and blacklist comparisons use the lowercased base email; today's main (sanitizeAndFilterGuests/deduplicateGuestEmails) still does this. The dialog's client-side `new Set(emails)` is still case-sensitive, but the server now drops case-variant duplicates and blocks case-variant blacklist bypass, so the buggy behaviour is gone.
